title: The White Rabbit's Clock
question: I have hands but cannot clap. I have a face but cannot smile. What am I?
rabbitHints: Think of something that tells you the time.
Its hands point, but they never touch.

title: The Cheshire Cat's Grin
question: The more you take away from me, the bigger I become. What am I?
rabbitHints: Imagine digging into the ground.
Removing more material makes the empty space larger.

title: The Mad Hatter's Tea
question: What gets wetter the more it dries?
rabbitHints: You use it after a shower.
It absorbs water from your skin.

title: The Locked Garden
question: I have keys but no locks. I have space but no room. You can enter, but you cannot go outside. What am I?
rabbitHints: You probably use one to type this answer.
It has letters, a space bar, and an Enter key.

title: The Queen's Cards
question: I can travel around the world while staying in one corner. What am I?
rabbitHints: Think of something placed on an envelope.
It stays in the corner while the letter travels.

title: The Teapot's Letter
question: What begins with T, ends with T, and has T in it?
rabbitHints: It is something you pour tea from.
Its name starts and ends with the same letter.

title: The White Rabbit's Glove
question: What has a thumb and four fingers but is not alive?
rabbitHints: You wear it on your hand.
It has fingers but no bones.

title: The Needle's Eye
question: What has one eye but cannot see?
rabbitHints: It is used together with thread.
Its eye is a hole for the thread to pass through.

title: The Silent Book
question: What has words but never speaks?
rabbitHints: You read it.
It has pages and a cover.

title: The Sleeping River
question: What has a bed but never sleeps?
rabbitHints: It flows toward the sea.
Its bed is made of earth, not blankets.

title: The Talking Shoe
question: What has a tongue but cannot taste?
rabbitHints: You wear it on your foot.
It has laces and a sole.

title: The Piano's Keys
question: What has many keys but cannot open a single lock?
rabbitHints: It has black and white keys.
You press its keys to make music.

title: The Toothy Crown
question: What has a crown but no king?
rabbitHints: You find it inside a mouth.
It has a crown and a root.

title: The Ship's Deck
question: What has a deck but no cards?
rabbitHints: It sails on the sea.
Its deck is a floor, not a pack of cards.

title: The Kettle's Beak
question: What has a beak but no bird?
rabbitHints: Oh dear! The Queen has corrupted the final trial of the Easy Chamber!
Her seal cannot be broken — no answer will ever be accepted here.

title: Down the Rabbit Hole
question: What has a neck but no head?
rabbitHints: You might find one holding water or juice.
It connects to a cap, not a head.

title: The Disappearing Cat
question: What belongs to you, but other people use it more than you do?
rabbitHints: People say it when they want your attention.
It identifies you, even when you’re not there.

title: The Crooked Signpost
question: What has cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and rivers but no water?
rabbitHints: You might use one when you’re lost.
It represents places without containing the real places.

title: The Talking Door
question: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with sound. What am I?
rabbitHints: Shout into a canyon and listen.
It’s a sound that comes back to you.

title: The Queen's Feast
question: I have many teeth, but I cannot bite. What am I?
rabbitHints: You might use it to tidy your hair.
Its teeth are close together, but they don’t chew.

title: The Miner's Secret
question: I am taken from a mine and shut up in a wooden case, from which I am never released, and yet I am used by almost everyone. What am I?
rabbitHints: You write with it.
It sits inside a wooden case, far from the mine now.

title: The Silent Room
question: What is so fragile that saying its name breaks it?
rabbitHints: A whisper can break it.
It is the absence of sound.

title: The Invisible Filler
question: What can fill a room but takes up no space?
rabbitHints: Flip a switch and it fills the room.
It casts shadows but occupies no space.

title: The Growing Dark
question: The more of me there is, the less you see. What am I?
rabbitHints: It grows when the sun sets.
It is the absence of light.

title: The Right Elbow
question: What can you hold in your left hand but not in your right hand?
rabbitHints: The Queen has corrupted the final trial of the Medium Chamber!
No answer can undo her seal — this riddle was never meant to be solved.

title: The Potion Bottle
question: What goes up but never comes down?
rabbitHints: It increases as the years pass.
Think about how old you are.

title: The Two Doors
question: A farmer has 10 rabbits. All but 3 run away. How many rabbits remain?
rabbitHints: Pay attention to the words ‘all but 3’.
If all except three run away, those three remain.

title: The Mirror Room
question: What can you catch but cannot throw?
rabbitHints: People often say they ‘catch’ this when they get sick.
It is a common illness, not an object.

title: The Caterpillar's Question
question: What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?
rabbitHints: Look carefully at the words ‘minute’ and ‘moment’.
The answer is a letter found in those words, not a number.

title: The Final Gate
question: I am always in front of you, but you can never see me. What am I?
rabbitHints: The Queen has corrupted the final trial of the castle!
No answer will ever pass this gate — but the flag may yet be found elsewhere.
